scenes.text: Draw or count repeated tile groups; use the difference to predict the number in later figures.
Figure counts: 4, 7, 10, ... What is figure 7? The answer is 22. Add 3 each time: 4 plus (7 minus 1) times 3 equals 22.
A tile design during a reading competition has 4, 9, 14, ... tiles in successive figures. How many tiles are in figure 9? Pause to choose and explain.
A tile design during a reading competition has 4, 9, 14, ... tiles in successive figures. How many tiles are in figure 9? The answer is 44. Add 5 each time: 4 plus (9 minus 1) times 5 equals 44.
